summary: Essential Properties, L.P. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a proposed offering of senior notes due 20XX, guaranteed by Essential Properties Realty Trust, Inc. Terms (interest rate, maturity, redemption provisions) are not yet filled in. Proceeds will go to Essential Properties, L.P. The notes are unsecured and a new issue with no established trading market; no listing is planned. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
